vb_textbox.text: for the first half od the game i felt that the round hats gave more mushrooms than the pointed hats. when both were round hats, i felt the purple ones were more likely to give less mushrooms. however, in the second half of the game it was the opposite. purple pointed hats lead to more mushrooms for the majority of the time. in both halves though i sometimes just went with gut feeling about how i felt in that second about the colour and picked which i personally preferred.
